The color of an eggplant is purple.

The cohesion of the approaching text is strong. The transitions and linking devices effectively guide the reader through the logical progression of ideas. The use of "Moreover" adds supporting information to the initial claim about climate change. "Therefore" correctly introduces the consequence or action taken in response to the previous statements. Finally, "These efforts" serves as a clear anaphoric reference to the investments in renewable energy, tying the specific actions back to the broader goal of a sustainable future. This creates a smooth and logical flow from problem to solution to significance.
